question: Is third_party/SlotSPE identical to the official https://github.com/zylvemvet/SlotSPE.git ?
verdict: MODEL-FORWARD IDENTICAL; three non-model files carry local adaptations that do not touch the audited code path.

upstream_reference_used.why: The machine has no outbound HTTPS (DNS resolves, TCP :443 times out), so the official repo could not be cloned directly.
upstream_reference_used.proxy_used: /home/ubuntu/newSlotSPE -- git repo of origin git@github.com:LDT-von/newSlotSPE.git, a fork that imported zylvemvet/SlotSPE in a single commit 1e89fca and never modified models/ afterwards.

models/SlotSPE.py.diff_summary: captum-only omic_names flattening: upstream uses a list comprehension; local uses np.asarray + np.concatenate + np.unique.
models/SlotSPE.py.why_inert_here: The block is guarded by `if omic_names != []`. survot_rank/research/slotspe_proof/model.py make_args() never sets omic_names, so it defaults to [] and the branch never executes.

utils/core_utils.py.diff_summary: upstream hard-codes /data/CPathPatchFeature/blca/{encoder}/pt_files; local uses args.data_root_dir. Local adds flush=True / log_file.flush() to print calls.
utils/core_utils.py.flush_change_provenance: commit cd33a3b 'Add v3.10/v3.11 monitoring scripts and SlotSPE v3.10 tools' -- the only commit in DCT-Reg history that touched third_party/SlotSPE.
utils/core_utils.py.why: slotspe_proof/patient.py does not import core_utils at all; it builds its own data pipeline.

utils/process_args.py.diff_summary: CLI defaults only: upstream default data_root_dir ./CPathPatchFeature/blca/uni/pt_files plus a --wsi_encoder choice; local default is an absolute COADREAD path.
utils/process_args.py.why: CLI argument parser; the proof harness constructs args directly via make_args().

dataset/dataset_survival.py.diff_summary: upstream adds an auto-detect block that appends {study}/{encoder}/pt_files to wsi_path when the directory layout requires it.
dataset/dataset_survival.py.why: The proof harness overrides the factory (TrainBinningFactory) and reads WSI features itself from config['features_root']; the auto-detect block is never reached.
dataset/dataset_survival.py.note: survot_rank/research/slotspe_proof/checks.py DOES import dataset_survival.py, but only for AST-level provenance checks of _setup_clinical_data / _get_uncensored_data / _disc_label, not for data loading.

cross_copy_consistency.note: Six independent SlotSPE copies exist on this machine; models/slot_attention.py hashes identically in all six.

delivery_package_consistency.note: docs/deliveries/slotspe_clean_original_audit_20261019_v1.zip preserves upstream mtimes (2026-04-17) and hashes identical to the live tree for all four models/*.py files.

git_history.models/: never modified in DCT-Reg history (slot_attention.py byte-identical from first commit b84e5c0 to HEAD)

conclusion: The audited forward/training path -- slot attention, slot decoder, top-k gate, transformer, omics encoder -- is byte-identical to the upstream code. The only upstream/local divergences are a captum-only branch that is unreachable in this harness, CLI defaults, a path auto-detect block that is unreachable, and log flushing. No difference can explain or create the gate-collapse measurement.
residual_caveat: The comparison baseline is the LDT-von/newSlotSPE fork's single import commit of zylvemvet/SlotSPE, NOT a direct fetch of zylvemvet/SlotSPE, because outbound HTTPS to github.com is blocked on this machine. The fork commit was never modified, so it is a faithful mirror, but a direct upstream fetch on a networked machine would close the loop definitively.
